denial_is_appealable.instructions: On the face of this letter, is the denial appealable by the provider?

criteria.yes: the letter gives a denial reason that a provider can rebut with clinical or coding evidence
criteria.no: the letter states the claim is not appealable or the time to appeal has passed
criteria.insufficient_evidence: the letter does not state a denial reason or an appeal right

appeal_window_open.instructions: Is the appeal filing window still open as at the letter date?

criteria.no: the appeal deadline has already passed
criteria.insufficient_evidence: no deadline or filing window is stated
